content.title: Brookfield Infrastructure: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HAMILTON, Bermuda (AP) — Brookfield Infrastructure Partners LP (BIP) on Friday reported a key measure of profitability in its third quarter. The real estate investment trust, based in Hamilton, Bermuda, said it had funds from operations of $654 million, or 83 cents per share, in the period. Funds from operations is a closely watched measure in the REIT industry.
